note: T0b archive/facts result baselines recorded from MemGQL-era devkit; baseline=memgql trusted, baseline=sql-truth needs reviewer-derived rows

entries.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.period_start_date AS period_start_date, flow.period_end_date AS period_end_date, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 10
USE archive_topology MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_ADDRESS]->(m:Address) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, m.address AS member_address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 10

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
USE archive_topology MATCH (:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(:Identity) RETURN flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, count(flow) AS flow_edges LIMIT 10

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WHERE flow.period_granularity = "daily" RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

USE archive_topology MATCH (t:TopologySnapshot) RETURN t.graph_name AS graph_name, t.topology_tier AS topology_tier, t.default_period_granularity AS default_period_granularity, t.min_period_start_date AS min_period_start_date, t.max_period_end_date AS max_period_end_date, t.available_granularities AS available_granularities LIMIT 10

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WHERE flow.amount_usd_sum IS NOT NULL RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
USE archive_topology MATCH (:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(:Identity) RETURN DISTINCT flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity LIMIT 10

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WITH dst, sum(flow.amount_usd_sum) AS total_usd, count(flow) AS flow_edges RETURN dst.identity_id AS to_identity, total_usd, flow_edges ORDER BY total_usd DESC LIMIT 25

USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum > 100000 THEN "high" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum > 1000 THEN "medium" ELSE "low" END AS amount_band LIMIT 25
USE archive_topology MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN count(i) AS identity_count LIMIT 1
USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_FEATURE]->(f:AddressFeature) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, f.tx_out_count AS tx_out_count, f.tx_in_count AS tx_in_count LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:HAS_LABEL]->(label:AddressLabel) RETURN label.label AS label, label.entity_type AS entity_type, label.source AS source LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, i.labels AS labels, i.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_RISK_SCORE]->(r:RiskScore) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, r.risk_score AS risk_score, r.window_days AS window_days, r.xgboost_model_version AS xgboost_model_version LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Asset) WHERE a.coingecko_id IS NOT NULL RETURN a.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol, a.asset_contract AS asset_contract, a.pricing_tier AS pricing_tier, a.verified AS verified ORDER BY a.asset_symbol ASC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (n:NeuronEndpoint) WHERE n.netuid = 15 RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, n.coldkey_address AS coldkey_address, n.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, n.netuid AS netuid, n.ip_address AS ip_address, n.axon_port AS axon_port ORDER BY n.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[hne:HAS_NEURON_ENDPOINT]->(n:NeuronEndpoint) RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, hne.netuid AS netuid, hne.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, hne.ip_address AS ip_address, hne.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY hne.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[reg:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey) WHERE reg.netuid = 15 RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, reg.netuid AS netuid, reg.observation_count AS observation_count, reg.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY reg.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (h:Hotkey) RETURN h.address AS address, h.netuids AS netuids, h.observation_count AS observation_count, h.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, h.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY h.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey)-[sf:SERVED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, ip.ip_address AS ip_address, sf.axon_port AS axon_port, sf.prometheus_port AS prometheus_port, sf.netuid AS netuid LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[op:OPERATED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) WHERE op.netuid = 15 RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, op.netuid AS netuid, op.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, op.axon_port AS axon_port, op.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (ip:IPAddress) RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, ip.netuids AS netuids, ip.observation_count AS observation_count, ip.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY ip.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l:AddressLabel) RETURN l.label AS label, count(l) AS label_count ORDER BY label_count DESC LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l:AddressLabel) RETURN DISTINCT l.entity_type AS entity_type LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_RISK_SCORE]->(r:RiskScore) WHERE r.risk_score IS NOT NULL RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, r.risk_score AS risk_score, r.window_days AS window_days, r.processing_date AS processing_date ORDER BY r.risk_score DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_FEATURE]->(f:AddressFeature) RETURN f.feature_scope AS feature_scope, count(f) AS features, sum(f.total_volume_usd) AS total_volume_usd ORDER BY total_volume_usd DESC LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN count(i) AS identity_count LIMIT 1
